easy: To sit or lie in a relaxed way.

ex.en: My cat lounges on the sofa all day.
ex.ko: 우리 고양이는 하루 종일 소파에서 느긋하게 쉰다.

easy: Something good happened by chance.

ex.en: Luckily, it stopped raining before our game.
ex.ko: 다행히 경기 전에 비가 그쳤다.

easy: A writer's copy of a book before it is printed.

ex.en: The author sent her manuscript to the publisher.
ex.ko: 작가는 출판사에 원고를 보냈다.

easy: A book or paper written by hand.

ex.en: The museum has a manuscript written long ago.
ex.ko: 박물관에는 아주 오래전에 손으로 쓴 필사본이 있다.

easy: Soldiers who are trained to work on land and at sea.

ex.en: My uncle served in the marines.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 해병대에서 복무하셨다.

easy: A plant with green leaves that smell fresh and are used for flavor.

ex.en: I picked mint leaves for my tea.
ex.ko: 나는 차에 넣으려고 민트 잎을 땄다.

easy: Telling someone about something.

ex.en: I got a notification that my package arrived.
ex.ko: 택배가 도착했다는 알림을 받았다.

easy: A star that suddenly gets much brighter for a while.

ex.en: Astronomers saw a nova in the night sky.
ex.ko: 천문학자들은 밤하늘에서 신성을 발견했다.

easy: A meal made mostly of noodles.

ex.en: We had pasta with tomato sauce for dinner.
ex.ko: 우리는 저녁으로 토마토소스 파스타를 먹었다.

easy: Dried dough made from flour and water, like spaghetti.

ex.en: I like to twirl pasta around my fork.
ex.ko: 나는 파스타를 포크에 돌돌 말아 먹는 것이 좋다.

easy: A paper that shows you paid for something.

ex.en: Keep the receipt in case you need to return it.
ex.ko: 반품할 수도 있으니 영수증을 보관해라.

easy: To say that someone did something good.

ex.en: The school recognized Ben for his kindness.
ex.ko: 학교는 벤의 친절함을 인정하고 칭찬했다.

easy: To see or hear something and know what it is.

ex.en: I recognized my dog's bark right away.
ex.ko: 나는 우리 개가 짖는 소리를 바로 알아챘다.

easy: Being someone or something you can count on.

ex.en: A good friend shows reliability by keeping promises.
ex.ko: 좋은 친구는 약속을 지키며 믿음직함을 보여준다.

easy: A person who studies something to learn new things.

ex.en: A researcher studies how bees make honey.
ex.ko: 연구원이 꿀벌이 꿀을 만드는 방법을 연구한다.

easy: An art piece you can see from all sides, like a statue.

ex.en: There is a sculpture of a horse in the park.
ex.ko: 공원에는 말 조각품이 있다.

easy: The art of making figures out of stone, wood, or clay.

ex.en: He learned sculpture from his grandfather.
ex.ko: 그는 할아버지께 조각을 배웠다.

easy: To make a figure by shaping stone, wood, or clay.

ex.en: She sculpted a small bird from clay.
ex.ko: 그녀는 점토로 작은 새를 조각했다.

easy: A device that notices things like heat or light and reacts.

ex.en: The sensor turns on the light when I walk in.
ex.ko: 내가 들어서면 센서가 불을 켠다.

easy: A glass box that shows things in a store or museum.

ex.en: The shiny medals sat in a showcase.
ex.ko: 반짝이는 메달이 진열장 안에 놓여 있었다.

easy: Cooked or kept by hanging in smoke, like some meat and fish.

ex.en: We ate smoked salmon on a bagel.
ex.ko: 우리는 베이글에 훈제 연어를 얹어 먹었다.

easy: A company that is owned by a bigger company.

ex.en: The toy maker is a subsidiary of a bigger company.
ex.ko: 그 장난감 회사는 더 큰 회사의 자회사이다.

easy: Helping the main one, but less important.

ex.en: The school has a main building and a subsidiary building for art.
ex.ko: 학교에는 본관과 미술 수업을 위한 부속 건물이 있다.

easy: One of ten equal parts.

ex.en: I ate one tenth of the pizza.
ex.ko: 나는 피자의 10분의 1을 먹었다.

easy: Number ten in a line or list.

ex.en: I finished tenth in the race.
ex.ko: 나는 달리기에서 10등으로 들어왔다.
